_why: Row 39 closed set: the only sqlite paths any pod container may bind, and which declared roles may bind each. Placement (WHERE) will be persist's job when it exists (row 8); until then this file is the authority and check_store_bindings.py gates it. A path here is a file triple (db/-wal/-shm), not a filename. Host-relative database.yml defaults (db/*.sqlite3) are build/test conveniences and are NOT members -- only container paths are governed.

stores.notes: Application state + BACK's operation journal (rows 52, 53, 73). back+backjob are declared co-writers (ADR 0056); bus mounts read-only as the projection source (row 72: BACK never dials bus).
BUS metadata projection (row 18). Own file since f14529b; dies on down -v and recomputes from the journal.
Ephemeral nondeterministic inference state (ADR 0057). NOOA refuses a second writer (row 45); mind is not a Rails ROLE so its binder is the service name.
